title: Repository-scoped unattended Codex permissions
scope: Configure durable Codex permissions for unattended normal development only in the CarbTune Pro repository while retaining safeguards outside that repository.
objectives: Use only installed-version-supported Codex configuration keys.
Allow normal repository reads, edits, validation, builds, and ordinary Git/GitHub workflow without repeated manual approval.
Keep destructive, unrelated, privilege, credential, and machine-wide operations outside the unattended boundary.
Validate, commit, push, and record an exact handoff.
constraints: Do not use danger-full-access or bypass approval and sandbox safeguards.
Prefer trusted project-local configuration over user-global or machine-wide grants.
Do not weaken the existing hook trust or CarbTune supervision architecture.
Do not perform destructive security testing.

acceptanceTests.expected: Installed Codex strictly loads the project configuration.
Controlled repository read, edit, validation, Git staging/commit, and normal push-path checks complete without an unresolved user approval wait.
The effective policy remains repository-scoped and documents protected/out-of-scope operations.

implementationNotes: Work started from a freshly fetched and fast-forwarded origin/main checkout.
